issues.title: Pacific Ring of Fire: Shaking in Australia after magnitude 6.8 earthquake rocks Timor-Leste
issues.title_en: Pacific Ring of Fire: Shaking in Australia after magnitude 6.8 earthquake rocks Timor-Leste
issues.summary: A magnitude 6.8 earthquake struck the Banda Sea about 65 miles northeast of Timor-Leste in Southeast Asia just after 4:30 a.m. ET (6:30 p.m. local time), according to the USGS.
issues.volunteer_impact: 기상 및 재난 상황에 따라 현장 활동과 이동 일정이 변경될 수 있습니다.
issues.recommended_action: 현지 협력기관과 상황을 공유하고 활동 전 안전 상황을 확인하세요.
